## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (and `npm run e2e` if the UI changed)
- [ ] A changeset is included for user-facing changes (`npx changeset`)
- [ ] Docs or reference pages are updated when behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal vault content are included
